execution_boundary.network: fresh empty user/network namespace with loopback only for each pytest invocation

interpretation: The observed true value establishes fixture-backed runtime enforcement at the source revision. It does not launch, authorize, or bypass a live NUC, provider, publication, deployment, or production approval gate.

checks: test_invalid_approval_has_no_preparation_effects: rejection occurs before the task root or attempt database is created
test_real_signed_approval_and_negative_controls: operator signatures, scope, expiration, image identity, and reviewed build inputs are verified
approval_gates.command: unshare --user --map-root-user --net sh -c 'ip link set lo up && exec env PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python -m pytest stapled-factory/deployment/nuc/test_prepare_dispatch.py stapled-factory/worker/tests/test_image_approval.py -q'

operator_workflow_context.command: unshare --user --map-root-user --net sh -c 'ip link set lo up && exec env PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python -m pytest stapled-factory/deployment/nuc/test_operator_workflow.py -q'

checks: mismatched capability or identity cannot spend; successor reservations share one atomic authority
missing authority denies without recreation and policy ceilings cannot be recreated or increased
concurrent proxy requests and monetary reservations cannot exceed their configured ceilings
spend_gates.command: unshare --user --map-root-user --net sh -c 'ip link set lo up && exec env PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python -m pytest stapled-factory/worker/tests/test_budget_authority.py stapled-factory/worker/tests/test_egress_proxy.py -q'

value_definition: True only when the approval-gate and spend-gate test selections both exit 0 at the measured source revision; local fixture-backed enforcement is measured without activating a live runtime.
